name: Zypento Mailchimp Integration
author: sproutient

sections.description:
Easily integrate WordPress with Mailchimp. This plugin allows you to create and manage Mailchimp audiences, delete Mailchimp audiences, and insert a subscription form for Mailchimp into posts and pages using WordPress blocks. Users can also select which Mailchimp audience each block subscribes to.

Features:
* Create and manage Mailchimp audiences directly from WordPress.
* Delete existing Mailchimp audiences.
* Insert a subscription form for Mailchimp using WordPress blocks.
* Select different Mailchimp audiences per block for targeted signups.
* Seamless integration for Mailchimp with WordPress block editor.
* Easy-to-use settings and configuration.

External services

This plugin connects to Mailchimp API, it’s needed to create your audience and add people who subscribe to that audience.

This service is provided by “Intuit Mailchimp”: terms of use, privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Zypento Mailchimp plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via the WordPress Plugin Installer.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Dashboard > Zypento Mailchimp to configure your Mailchimp API key.
  4. Use the provided Zypento Mailchimp block in the block editor to insert signup forms on pages and posts.
sections.faq:
How do I connect my Mailchimp account?

Go to Dashboard > Zypento Mailchimp and click on settings tab and enter your Mailchimp API key. This will allow the plugin to interact with your Mailchimp account.

Can I use different audiences for different signup forms?

Yes! Each subscription block allows you to choose which Mailchimp audience users will be subscribed to.

Do I need a Mailchimp account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need an active Mailchimp account with API access.
